{{Quote|Trista, have the Daphoros execute a tractor beam capture of Sharmok seven-eighteen as soon as the engines have been disabled, then send a boarding company to retake&ndash;|[[Tenel Ka Djo]] to [[Trista Zel]]|<ref name="Apocalypse" />}}
The '''''Daphoros''''' was one of the [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s belonging to the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] in [[44 ABY]] under command of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Hapan]] [[Unidentified Daphoros commander|commander]]. It assisted in the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the [[New Jedi Order]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]], where it tried to lock the Hapan transport ''[[Sharmok 718]]'' under a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />
